title: Codebase tightness audit June 2026
summary: Read-only audit rates zonoid around 6.5/10 tight: strong dependency minimalism and broad behavior-close tests, but current main is not green (npm test: 200/202 files passed; guidance-resolve and note-decay-subsumption failed), central orchestration remains large/coupled (daemon.js, buildGraph side effects, broad route ctx), .graph runtime state is tracked heavily (2091 files, 103M, merge=ours), and npm audit reports @xenova/transformers transitive protobufjs/onnxruntime high/critical advisories. Highest leverage cleanup is splitting buildGraph into pure projection plus explicit reconciliation/write phases.
